summary.text: John Martin is a Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Merrimack 9, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously represented Merrimack 23 in the House from 2014 to 2016.

paragraphs.text: Martin ran for the House as a Republican in 2012 and was defeated in the general election, and he served in the Merrimack 23 seat from 2014 to 2016.
He advanced from the Republican primary for Merrimack 23 in 2018 and 2020, and Christopher Lins defeated him in the special Republican primary for the seat on April 20, 2021.
In 2024 he was one of four Republicans to advance from the Merrimack 9 primary and did not win a seat in the general election.
